definitions.explanation: Liquid discharge from the nose, typically due to a cold, allergies, or irritation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひいて→引く：01978_hiku⟧{鼻水|はなみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a cold and can't stop my runny nose.

examples.japanese: {鼻水|はなみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{拭|ふ}いた→拭く：04261_fuku⟧。
examples.english: I wiped my runny nose with a tissue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鼻水|はなみず}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痒|かゆ}み→かゆみ：07278_kayumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: My runny nose and itchy eyes are bad due to hay fever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鼻水|はなみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}らしている→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧。
examples.english: The child has a runny nose.

examples.japanese: {鼻水|はなみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ほうが→方：01139_hou⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When you have a bad runny nose, it's better to take medicine and rest early.

notes:
{鼻水|はなみず} refers to nasal discharge (runny nose).

Common expressions:
- {鼻水|はなみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to have a runny nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (can't stop one's runny nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe one's nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧ (to have a dripping nose)
- {鼻水|はなみず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すする→啜る：05127_susuru⟧ (to sniff/sniffle)
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かむ→噛む：01205_kamu⟧ (to blow one's nose)

Related symptoms:
- ⟦くしゃみ→くしゃみ：04428_kushami⟧ (sneezing)
- ⟦{鼻|はな}づまり→鼻詰まり：16227_hanazumari⟧ (stuffy nose)
- ⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧ (cough)

Note:
{鼻水|はなみず} is a common symptom of both colds (⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧) and allergies (⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧). The word literally means "nose water." More formal or medical terms include ⟦{鼻汁|びじゅう}→鼻汁：29135_bijuu⟧.
